title: Universal Server Finder
features:
🔎 Ultimate Server Finder v1 — Advanced Server Browser & Smart-Hop

Wanted a proper server finder that actually gives control instead of a basic list, so this script was built to fix that. fast, clean, works in any game - just execute and use the panel.

What it does:

-     search for any server directly by JobId

-     instant join to any selected server

-     multi‑page server browser with the ability to load 100+ servers

-     load more button to fetch even more available servers

-     filters for Players, Lowest Players, Ping

-     auto‑refresh mode (recommended to keep default refresh delay)

-     manual Refresh button if you want to update the server list yourself

-     Join Smallest button — instantly connects you to the server with the lowest player count

-     Rejoin button to rejoin to your current server

-     Misc tab includes a button to copy the Discord server link

Requirements & notes:

1.     your character must be alive (Humanoid required)

2.     the server must not be full — ensures teleport works without issues

3.     works on most executors that support basic teleport functions

if something doesn’t load or fails to fetch servers, your executor may not support the required functions.

Enjoy the script and feel free to share ideas or issues in the Discord.
